archetypes.name: Red-White Artifacts
archetypes.plan: Build around Porcelain Legionnaire: Deploy artifacts and equipment early, reward their presence with efficient threats, and attack before value decks stabilize.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Infect
archetypes.plan: Build around Blighted Agent: Protect evasive infect creatures with counters and removal, then proliferate to finish the poison race.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Proliferate
archetypes.plan: Build around Viral Drake: Establish useful counters on creatures or artifacts, then proliferate while evasive threats maintain pressure.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Infect Control
archetypes.plan: Build around Fallen Ferromancer: Use removal to clear lanes for infect threats and proliferate or equipment to shorten the poison clock.

archetypes.name: Green-White Golems
archetypes.plan: Build around Vital Splicer: Produce artifact creatures and Golems, then use shared bonuses to turn the assembled board into a decisive attack.
